## Parent

[#37 — Spec: One-window IDE with project tabs and shared Agents](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/37)

## What to build

Single-folder and saved multi-folder projects open, reuse exact workspace/environment matches, retain editing context, and support ordering, scrolling and path disambiguation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Open one real single-folder and one saved multi-folder workspace beside Agents, each with independent workspace configuration/storage/trust, profile, extensions and editor context.
- [x] Identify single-folder projects by exact folder plus environment and saved multi-folder projects by exact workspace file plus environment; overlapping folders, distinct workspace files, worktrees and local/SSH/Dev Container authorities remain distinct.
- [x] Repeated exact-target requests activate the existing tab, choosing its most recently active exact match if duplicates already exist; new projects append on the right.
- [x] Switching changes selection, bounds, visibility and focus without recreating or suspending a workbench; dirty editors, layout, sidebar context and focus history remain intact.
- [ ] Support drag reordering, path disambiguation and independently scrolling project/editor strips while Agents remains accessible; hidden views cannot receive keyboard or accessibility interaction.
- [ ] Exercise repeated project-to-Agents-to-project switching and exact-target reuse through the real desktop boundary, with focused identity/service regressions for ambiguous names and overlapping workspaces.

## Execution boundary

This is an approved implementation slice within [#34](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/34). Inspect and reuse its published disposable baseline; implement only missing behaviour using existing services and test infrastructure. Preserve the full accepted contract in #37 and its authoritative linked resolutions, including requirements not repeated here.

Use a named bounded scenario, isolated app-owned state and scratch workspaces. Record exact source/build, focused checks, failures/repairs and unperformed coverage. [#35](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/35) retains the full staged runtime acceptance gate and separate creator verdict. Provider work/sign-in remains deferred and authorization probes remain paused. Publication does not start execution, lift those limits, establish feasibility or authorize a production merge.

Partial implementation checkpoint — leave this issue open.

Exact folder/workspace-file plus environment matching, most-recent exact reuse, retained tabs, paths and ordering are integrated (`e2265e460f7`, merge `cf36c4a7d2b`). #41 adds selected-only attachment (`52f6f8033eeb`). Six finder tests and targeted lint passed. Earlier native dirty-editor retention and AX exclusion passed at52f6f; these are historical bounded checks, not a current-source full ticket pass.

Unchecked criteria5–6: perform current-source native drag reordering, independent strip overflow/path disambiguation and exact-target reuse/switching checks. Retain the native keyboard/AX requirement. Remote identity service tests are not real remote validation.

No open native blockers. This is the next unblocked ticket. Checked criteria describe only established source/service or explicitly recorded runtime behavior; unchecked compound criteria remain incomplete. A merge or unit pass is not full runtime acceptance.

Checkpoint source `403375db5f1794d95849d795ceecbf8553d2dfdb`; integration branch `integration/spec-37-complete`; draft [PR #60](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/pull/60). [Committed handoffs, evidence and review](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/blob/d71ae1f23b018cfc7f99616d24f187dc96375ea6/prototypes/live-hosting/spec-37/checkpoint-2026-10-28/README.md). Orchestration is stopped; no worker remains assigned. Provider work/sign-in stays deferred, authorization probes stay paused, no production merge is authorized, and #35 retains full staged acceptance plus the separate creator verdict.
